subject: Commercial next steps and approval request — EchoAI pilot purchasing path
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:10:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Intro / discovery — EchoAI (pilot) — post-call recap

Team — quick recap from today's call with Sofia (EchoAI) + next steps. TL;DR: strong fit for a 3–6 month pilot focused on search/answer rerank; economic buyer is Sofia Delgado (Head of Product). Procurement/legal will route through procurement@echoai.com. Security contact is Adam Liu (security@echoai.com) — he did not join today but requested SOC2 + architecture diagram.

Stakeholder map (high level):
- Economic buyer: Sofia Delgado (Head of Product) — cares about speed of integration, model cost, and reduction in latency for search features.
- Technical champion: Miguel Torres (Frontend lead, on call) — will own integration and eval prompts.
- Security: Adam Liu (not on call) — needs SOC 2 + network/data handling description.
- Procurement/Legal: procurement@echoai.com — will require standard PO/contract review (6–8 week timeline typical).

Decision criteria (per Sofia):
- Latency under 150ms p95 for 512-token inference
- Unit cost target ~ $0.0006/token equivalent for pilot
- Evidence of SOC2/controls and ability to run in VPC if required

Ask from our side:
- Approve a buying-process exception to offer a pilot discount (20% off list for 3 months) and a pilot SLA (99.5% uptime, 100ms tail not guaranteed) to accelerate procurement.
- Approve sending the attached SOW draft + procurement questionnaire.

Attachments: EchoAI_SOW_draft.pdf (draft SOW, commercial terms) and procurement_questionnaire.xlsx (security + procurement checklist).

Next steps:
1) I will send Sofia the SOW draft and questionnaire today; ask procurement timeline and security contacts (action: Jonas).
2) Connor to confirm integration estimate and whether any infra changes are required (action: Connor).
3) If procurement pushes long review, propose pilot start on sign-of-SOW + Temp PO.

Please flag if you object to the 20% discount + pilot SLA exception. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll route to Rishi for formal approval.

-- 
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0191

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: RE: Intro / discovery — EchoAI (pilot) — post-call recap

Jonas — looks good. A couple of quick notes: the SOW should call out renewal pricing and a 30-day notice to change pricing post-pilot. Also recommend we add a one-time onboarding credit (covers 10k tokens equivalent) instead of a deeper price cut if leadership prefers.

Connor — can you confirm the estimated effort (dev hours) for integration? Miguel seemed comfortable but we should call out any engineering dependencies in SOW.

If no objections, Rishi should approve the pilot discount as a sales exception.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Delgado <sofia@echoai.com>
Cc: procurement@echoai.com
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Next steps + draft SOW (EchoAI pilot)

Hi Sofia — thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, attached is a short pilot SOW and a procurement/security questionnaire to help your team evaluate. Quick recap and ask:

- Pilot scope: 3 months, up to 50M tokens total, integration with your search API, observability hooks for latency/cost.
- Proposed commercial: 20% pilot discount off standard hosted rates (we can convert to credits if preferred).
- Proposed SLA for pilot: 99.5% availability; we will not guarantee tail latency for pilot but will provide metrics and alerts.

Attachments: EchoAI_SOW_draft.pdf (draft SOW), procurement_questionnaire.xlsx (security + procurement checklist).

Questions for you:
1) Who will own procurement/legal review on your side? (I have procurement@echoai.com copied)
2) Can Adam Liu or someone from security share SOC2 and/or architecture diagram?
3) Preferred timeline for pilot sign — you mentioned early April as possible; is a 2–3 week review realistic?

We can be flexible on billing (credit vs PO) to move faster.

Cheers —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: EchoAI_SOW_draft.pdf]
[Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Sofia Delgado <sofia@echoai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@echoai.com
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps + draft SOW (EchoAI pilot)

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. A couple of notes from procurement:

- Procurement timeline: legal will want ~60 days for review unless we can provide standard contracts + SOC2 evidence. They prefer to have a full questionnaire completed first.
- Security: Adam asked for SOC2 Type II report and a short network/data flow diagram. He also asked about data retention and deletion policy for pilot logs.
- Commercials: the product team (me) likes the 3-month pilot but needs confirmation on the discount approval from finance/legal for any non-standard SLA/terms.

We can move quicker if you can provide a SOC2 redaction and a short one-page security summary. Also, would you consider a staged commercial: 10% off list for month 1, with an option to expand to 20% if we opt into a 6-month renewal? That helps legal/finance see a path to scale.

Procurement@echoai.com: please confirm who will own contract review.

Sofia Delgado
Head of Product | EchoAI
sofia@echoai.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 08:20:00 -0400
Subject: Approval request — pilot discount + SLA exception for EchoAI (DEAL-2026-0397)

Rishi — quick approval request. Summary:
- Account: EchoAI (Sofia Delgado)
- Ask: approve a buying-process exception to offer pilot pricing as follows: 3-month pilot, staged discount (10% month 1, 20% months 2–3) OR flat 20% pilot credit (sales can choose). Pilot SLA: 99.5% availability (non-standard for hosted API pilot).
- Reason: short sales cycle potential; product-team momentum; expected expansion to full deployment within 6–9 months (estimated ARR $210k).
- Risk mitigation: require signed SOW + procurement questionnaire returned; require SOC2 evidence before production expansion; set renewal pricing floor in SOW; include a 30-day notice clause for price changes.
- Attachments: EchoAI_SOW_draft.pdf, procurement_questionnaire.xlsx.

If you approve, please confirm any conditions (finance notification, required term language). Need decision today to keep momentum — EchoAI indicated procurement review could slow to 60 days without flexibility.

Thanks —
Jonas
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: EchoAI_SOW_draft.pdf]
[Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Approval request — pilot discount + SLA exception for EchoAI (DEAL-2026-0397)

Jonas — approved with conditions.

Conditions:
1) Use staged discount (10% first month, 20% months 2–3) rather than an upfront 20% unless finance signs off. This reduces revenue hit and gives us a datapoint for renewal.
2) Require SOC2 Type II redaction + one-page security summary before any production traffic.
3) Add renewal target and a fixed renewal price floor in SOW (work with Marissa on language).
4) Finance should be notified and a temporary PO flow offered if procurement requires it.

Connor/Marissa — please update the SOW to include the renewal floor, staged discount clause, and the 30-day price-change notice. Once updated, Jonas can send to Sofia with Rishi CC'd.

Rishi Malhotra
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
